senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קָדַשׁ)sanctuary, esp. מִ׳ or בֵּית הַמִּ׳ (abbr. בה״מ) the Jerusalem Temple, contrad. to משכן the Tabernacle.
units: Erub. 2ᵃ אשכחן משכן דאיקרי מ׳ ומ׳ וכ׳ we find that the Tabernacle is sometimes called miḳdash, and the Temple mishkan.—מ׳ ראשון the first Temple (the Solomonic Temple); מ׳ שני the second (post-exilic) Temple.
<cite ref="Yoma 21b:2-13">Ib.</cite> <he>בשעה … בה״מ</he> when Solomon had built the Temple; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִקְדָּשִׁים</he>.
<cite ref="Megillah 16b:2">Meg. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>שני מ׳</he> two sanctuaries (that of Shiloh and the Jerusalem Temple); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 152:1">Yalk. Gen. 152</cite>.
